How the five daily drawings differ

methods.title: How the play amount works
methods.summary: The prize is a multiple of the amount played on that number, so the same drawn number is worth different amounts on different tickets.
methods.limitation: A larger play amount scales both the cost and the prize. It does not change the chance of the number being drawn.

methods.title: Playing more than one daily drawing
methods.summary: The five daily drawings are separate games with separate results, so entering more than one is entering several independent drawings.
methods.limitation: Each drawing is independent. Entering several does not improve any single one.

methods.title: Setting a fixed entertainment budget
methods.summary: With five drawings a day, deciding an amount in advance and treating it as the cost of entertainment keeps play in proportion.
methods.limitation: No budget or number of entries changes the outcome of a drawing.
